summary: Virola Messenger is a proprietary self-hosted tool designed for team communication and project collaboration. It provides infrastructure for private and group text channels, persistent voice and video meetings, file transfers, and basic issue tracking through a built-in task board.
goodFor: It suits organisations looking for a single self-hosted alternative to proprietary platforms like Slack that combines chat, video conferencing, and task management in one system.
watchOut: The software is proprietary, has no public source code repository activity, and directly competes with mature, well-documented open-source alternatives like Mattermost or Rocket.Chat.
deployNotes: As a C++ application, you will typically need to run it behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination and configure persistent storage volumes for uploaded files and chat history.
